example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামের দুর্ভিক্ষে সবার হাল খারাপ হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The famine in the village has left everyone in dire straits.
His business losses have put him in endless misfortune.
history: This idiom originates from rural Bengali agrarian life, where a damaged plow (হাল) symbolizes failed crops and ensuing poverty, reflecting the hardships of farming communities.
note: Deeply tied to Bengal's rural economy and folklore.
